````html
        .tip-title {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .tip-description {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* Right Section */
        .right-section {
            width: 420px;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .auth-container {
            width: 320px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .lock-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            margin: 0 auto 20px;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border-radius: 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .lock-icon svg {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            stroke: var(--bg-primary);
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2;
        }

        .auth-title {
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .auth-subtitle {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 28px;
        }

        .input-group {
            text-align: left;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .input-label {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            display: block;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .input-wrapper {
            position: relative;
        }

        .input-field {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 14px 14px 14px 44px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 10px;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 15px;
            outline: none;
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
        }

        .input-field:focus {
            border-color: var(--accent-color);
        }

        .input-field::placeholder {
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .input-icon {
            position: absolute;
            left: 14px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            stroke: var(--text-muted);
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2;
        }

        .connect-button {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 14px;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 10px;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .connect-button:hover {
            opacity: 0.85;
        }

        .connect-button:disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .auth-footer {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .auth-link {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .auth-link:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* Window controls */
        .window-controls {
            position: absolute;
            top: 16px;
            right: 16px;
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
        }

        .control-button {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
        }

        .control-button:hover {
            background: var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .control-button.close:hover {
            background: #ef4444;
            border-color: #ef4444;
            color: white;
        }

        /* Loading state */
        .loading-spinner {
            display: none;
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            border-top: 2px solid white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        .connect-button.loading .button-text {
            display: none;
        }

        .connect-button.loading .loading-spinner {
            display: block;
        }

        /* Messages */
        .error-message,
        .success-message {
            display: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 10px 12px;
            font-size: 13px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .error-message {
            background: #fef2f2;
            border: 1px solid #fecaca;
            color: #dc2626;
        }

        .success-message {
            background: #f0fdf4;
            border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
            color: #16a34a;
        }

        .error-message.show,
        .success-message.show {
            display: block;
        }

        /* Authenticated state */
        .authenticated-state {
            display: none;
        }

        .authenticated-state.show {
            display: block;
        }

        .user-info-display {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .user-avatar-large {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin: 0 auto 12px;
        }

        .user-name-large {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .user-email-large {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .user-plan-large {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <!-- Left Section -->
    <div class="left-section">
        
        <div class="app-title">Control</div>
        <div class="app-subtitle">Software-use AI agent </div>
        <!-- <img src="./assets/icons/icon-removebg-preview.png" alt="Logo" style="width: 64px; height: 64px; margin-bottom: 24px; -webkit-app-region: no-drag;"> -->

        <div class="features-list">
            <div class="feature-item">
                <div class="feature-icon">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                        <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" />
                        <path d="M3 9h18M9 21V9" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div class="feature-content">
                    <h3>Overlay Mode</h3>
                    <p>Click-through overlay stays on top without blocking your workflow.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="feature-item">
                <div class="feature-icon">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
                        <path
                            d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div class="feature-content">
                    <h3>Settings</h3>
                    <p>Access settings and account management anytime from the panel.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="feature-item">
                <div class="feature-icon">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                        <path d="M18 8A6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9" />
                        <path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div class="feature-content">
                    <h3>Quick Toggle</h3>
                    <p id="hotkeyTipText">Press Ctrl+Space to toggle chat. Alt+Z to stop current task.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="tips-section">
            <h3 class="tips-title">Tips & Help</h3>
            <div class="tips-container">
                <!-- Tip 1 -->
                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12" />
                            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Avoid Interactions During ACT</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Don't interact with your computer while ACT mode is running tasks.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tip 2 -->
                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5" />
                            <path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Toggle Greetings</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Enable or disable greeting voice in settings. Greetings wait if
                            locked.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tip 3 -->
                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23" />
                            <path d="M16.72 11.06A10.94 10.94 0 0 1 19 12.55" />
                            <path d="M5 12.55a10.94 10.94 0 0 1 5.17-2.39" />
                            <path d="M10.71 5.05A16 16 0 0 1 22.58 9" />
                            <path d="M1.42 9a15.91 15.91 0 0 1 4.7-2.88" />
                            <path d="M8.53 16.11a6 6 0 0 1 6.95 0" />
                            <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12.01" y2="20" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Offline Mode</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Cached settings and account data work offline. Offline TTS is used
                            automatically.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tip 4 -->
                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M12 1a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v8a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V4a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z" />
                            <path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2" />
                            <line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="23" />
                            <line x1="8" y1="23" x2="16" y2="23" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Wake Word</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Say "Hey Control" to activate. Enable auto-send for automatic
                            transcription.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tip 5 -->
                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="2" ry="2" />
                            <line x1="6" y1="8" x2="18" y2="8" />
                            <line x1="6" y1="12" x2="18" y2="12" />
                            <line x1="6" y1="16" x2="12" y2="16" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Keyboard Shortcuts</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Ctrl+Space: Toggle chat | Alt+Z: Stop task | Escape: Clear input
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Tip 6 -->
                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path
                                d="M21.44 11.05l-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l9.19-9.19a4 4 0 0 1 5.66 5.66l-9.2 9.19a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Attachments</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Attach images, PDFs, or files. They display with your messages in
                            chat.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Extra Tips -->
                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
                            <path
                                d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Model Selection</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Choose between different AI models in settings to suit your needs.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M12 1a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v8a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V4a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z" />
                            <path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2" />
                            <line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="23" />
                            <line x1="8" y1="23" x2="16" y2="23" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Voice Response</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Enable voice responses for a more interactive audible experience.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" />
                            <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Pin Protection</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Secure your app with a PIN code in settings for extra privacy.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <polyline points="1 4 1 10 7 10" />
                            <polyline points="23 20 23 14 17 14" />
                            <path d="M20.49 9A9 9 0 0 0 5.64 5.64L1 10m22 4l-4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 1 3.51 15" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">History Access</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Scroll up in chat to view previous conversation history easily.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z" />
                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Window Visibility</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Toggle whether Control windows appear in screen recordings.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12" />
                            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Floating Button</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Use the floating button for quick access to tools from anywhere.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                            <polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Auto-Send</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Enable auto-send to skip pressing enter manually after dictation.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />

                            <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Task Cancellation</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Use the stop button or Alt+Z to cancel any running task
                            immediately.</div>

                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">

                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Multi-Monitor</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Control works across multiple monitors seamlessly and intuitively.

                <div class="tip-item">

                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Dark Mode</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">The interface adapts to your system's dark mode preferences
                            automatically.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2" />
                            <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Privacy Focused</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Your data is processed securely. We prioritize your privacy.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z" />
                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Context Awareness</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Control understands what's on your screen for better assistance.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Natural Language</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Speak naturally; Control understands context and intent without
                            commands.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M12 1a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v8a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V4a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z" />
                            <path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2" />
                            <line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="23" />
                            <line x1="8" y1="23" x2="16" y2="23" />
                        </svg></div>
                    <div class="tip-content">
                        <div class="tip-title">Text-to-Speech</div>
                        <div class="tip-description">Control can read out responses to you for eyes-free operation.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="tip-item">
                    <div class="tip-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M18 8A6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9" />
                            <path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0" />
                            <line x1="2" y1="2" x2="22" y2="22" />
                        </svg></div>
````

````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Ghost Cursor Overlay</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: transparent;
            cursor: none;
        }

        #ghostCursor {
            position: fixed;
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 999999;
            transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, opacity 0.15s ease-out;
        }

        #ghostCursor.hidden {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        #cursorSvg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        #textBubble {
            position: fixed;
            max-width: 300px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
            z-index: 999998;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease-out;
            word-wrap: break-word;
            background: #FFFFFF;
            color: #000000;
        }

        #textBubble.hidden {
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        #textBubble::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            background: inherit;
            transform: rotate(45deg);
        }

        #textBubble.above::after {
            bottom: -6px;
            left: 50%;
            margin-left: -6px;
        }

        #textBubble.below::after {
            top: -6px;
            left: 50%;
            margin-left: -6px;
        }

        #textBubble.left::after {
            right: -6px;
            top: 50%;
            margin-top: -6px;
        }

        #textBubble.right::after {
            left: -6px;
            top: 50%;
            margin-top: -6px;
        }

        #doneButton {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 8px;
            padding: 6px 12px;
            background: rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.3);
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: inherit;
            font-size: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        #doneButton:hover {
            background: rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.2);
            border-color: rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.5);
        }

        #customCursorImg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: contain;
            display: none;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="ghostCursor" class="hidden">
        <svg id="cursorSvg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="28" height="28">
            <path d="M4.037 4.688a.495.495 0 0 1 .651-.651l16 6.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.063.947l-6.124 1.58a2 2 0 0 0-1.438 1.435l-1.579 6.126a.5.5 0 0 1-.947.063z" fill="#1c1c1e" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        </svg>
        <img id="customCursorImg" alt="Custom cursor">
    </div>
    
    <div id="textBubble" class="hidden above">
        <span id="instructionText"></span>
        <button id="doneButton">Done</button>
    </div>

    <script>
        const ghostCursor = document.getElementById('ghostCursor');
        const cursorSvg = document.getElementById('cursorSvg');
        const cursorPath = document.getElementById('cursorPath');
        const customCursorImg = document.getElementById('customCursorImg');
        const textBubble = document.getElementById('textBubble');
        const instructionText = document.getElementById('instructionText');
        const doneButton = document.getElementById('doneButton');

        let currentX = 0;
        let currentY = 0;
        let targetX = 0;
        let targetY = 0;
        let mouseX = 0;
        let mouseY = 0;
        let isGuiding = false;
        let isIdleFollowing = false;
        let animationFrame = null;

        const settings = {
            cursorColor: '#0078D4',
            cursorOutlineColor: '#FFFFFF',
            cursorOpacity: 100,
            cursorSize: 'medium',
            bubbleBg: '#FFFFFF',
            bubbleTextColor: '#000000',
            customImage: null
        };

        const sizeMap = {
            small: 20,
            medium: 28,
            large: 40
        };

        function applySettings(newSettings) {
            Object.assign(settings, newSettings);
            
            const size = sizeMap[settings.cursorSize] || 32;
            ghostCursor.style.width = size + 'px';
            ghostCursor.style.height = size + 'px';
            
            ghostCursor.style.opacity = settings.cursorOpacity / 100;
            
            if (settings.customImage) {
                customCursorImg.src = settings.customImage;
                customCursorImg.style.display = 'block';
                cursorSvg.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                customCursorImg.style.display = 'none';
                cursorSvg.style.display = 'block';
                cursorPath.setAttribute('fill', settings.cursorColor);
                cursorPath.setAttribute('stroke', settings.cursorOutlineColor);
            }

            textBubble.style.background = settings.bubbleBg;
            textBubble.style.color = settings.bubbleTextColor;
        }

        function animate() {
            const dx = targetX - currentX;
            const dy = targetY - currentY;
            const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            
            if (distance > 1) {
                // Faster easing for more responsive following
                const easing = 0.35;
                currentX += dx * easing;
                currentY += dy * easing;
            } else {
                currentX = targetX;
                currentY = targetY;
            }

            // Offset cursor so pointer tip aligns with actual position
            ghostCursor.style.left = (currentX - 4) + 'px';
            ghostCursor.style.top = (currentY - 4) + 'px';

            updateBubblePosition();

            if (isGuiding || isIdleFollowing) {
                animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }
        }

        function updateBubblePosition() {
            const cursorRect = ghostCursor.getBoundingClientRect();
            const bubbleRect = textBubble.getBoundingClientRect();
            const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
            const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
            const padding = 10;

            let bubbleX = cursorRect.right + 15;
            let bubbleY = cursorRect.top;
            let position = 'left';

            if (bubbleX + bubbleRect.width > viewportWidth - padding) {
                bubbleX = cursorRect.left - bubbleRect.width - 15;
                position = 'right';
            }

            if (bubbleX < padding) {
                bubbleX = padding;
            }

            if (bubbleY + bubbleRect.height > viewportHeight - padding) {
                bubbleY = viewportHeight - bubbleRect.height - padding;
            }
            
            if (bubbleY < padding) {
                bubbleY = padding;
            }

            textBubble.style.left = bubbleX + 'px';
            textBubble.style.top = bubbleY + 'px';
            
            textBubble.classList.remove('above', 'below', 'left', 'right');
            textBubble.classList.add(position);
        }

        function moveTo(x, y, show = true) {
            targetX = x;
            targetY = y;
            
            if (show && ghostCursor.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                ghostCursor.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
            
            if ((isGuiding || isIdleFollowing) && !animationFrame) {
                animate();
            }
        }

        function showText(text, showDoneButton = true) {
            instructionText.textContent = text;
            doneButton.style.display = showDoneButton ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
            textBubble.classList.remove('hidden');
            updateBubblePosition();
        }

        function hideText() {
            textBubble.classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function setGuiding(guiding) {
            isGuiding = guiding;
            
            if (guiding) {
                // Guiding mode - show text bubble, move to AI-directed position
                stopIdleFollowing();
                textBubble.classList.remove('hidden');
                if (!animationFrame) {
                    animate();
                }
            } else {
                // Idle mode - follow user's mouse
                startIdleFollowing();
            }
        }

        function startIdleFollowing() {
            isIdleFollowing = true;
            ghostCursor.classList.remove('hidden');
            textBubble.classList.add('hidden');
            
            // Immediately get current mouse position
            targetX = mouseX;
            targetY = mouseY;
            currentX = targetX;
            currentY = targetY;
            
            // Remove any existing listener to avoid duplicates
            document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
            
            // Cancel existing animation and start fresh
            if (animationFrame) {
                cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
                animationFrame = null;
            }
            animate();
        }

        function stopIdleFollowing() {
            isIdleFollowing = false;
            document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
            
            if (!isGuiding) {
                ghostCursor.classList.add('hidden');
                textBubble.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        function onMouseMove(e) {
            mouseX = e.clientX;
            mouseY = e.clientY;
            if (isIdleFollowing && !isGuiding) {
                targetX = e.clientX;
                targetY = e.clientY;
            }
        }

        function onMouseMoveFromIPC(data) {
            mouseX = data.x;
            mouseY = data.y;
            if (isIdleFollowing && !isGuiding) {
                targetX = data.x;
                targetY = data.y;
            }
        }

        doneButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
            window.ghostCursorAPI.sendStepComplete();
        });

        if (window.ghostCursorAPI) {
            window.ghostCursorAPI.onMove((data) => {
                moveTo(data.x, data.y);
            });

            window.ghostCursorAPI.onUpdateText((data) => {
                showText(data.text, data.target !== null);
            });

            window.ghostCursorAPI.onSetGuiding((data) => {
                setGuiding(data.guiding);
            });

            window.ghostCursorAPI.onInitSettings && window.ghostCursorAPI.onInitSettings((data) => {
                applySettings(data);
            });

            window.ghostCursorAPI.onStartIdle(() => {
                // Start idle following when cursor is shown
                startIdleFollowing();
            });

            window.ghostCursorAPI.onMouseMove((data) => {
                onMouseMoveFromIPC(data);
            });
        }

        if (window.ghostCursorAPI && window.ghostCursorAPI.requestInitSettings) {
            window.ghostCursorAPI.requestInitSettings();
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            if (isGuiding) {
                updateBubblePosition();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
````

````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Control - Lite</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        :root {
            --bg-dark: #0a0a0f;
            --bg-card: rgba(15, 15, 25, 0.95);
            --bg-terminal: rgba(10, 10, 15, 0.98);
            --border-glow: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
            --text-primary: #e4e4e7;
            --text-secondary: #71717a;
            --text-muted: #52525b;
            --accent: #6366f1;
            --accent-glow: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
            --success: #22c55e;
            --error: #ef4444;
            --user-cursor: #22c55e;
            --ai-cursor: #6366f1;
        }

        body {
            --bg-dark: #000000;
            --bg-card: rgba(15, 15, 20, 0.98);
            --bg-terminal: rgba(5, 5, 10, 0.99);
            --border-glow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            --text-primary: #ffffff;
            --text-secondary: #a1a1aa;
            --text-muted: #52525b;
            --accent: #ffffff;
            --accent-glow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        }

        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: transparent !important;
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        .lite-container {
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 16px;
            gap: 12px;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Header Bar - Minimal */
        .lite-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 8px;
            -webkit-app-region: drag;
        }

        .lite-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .lite-logo::before {
            content: '';
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--user-cursor);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--user-cursor);
        }

        .lite-mode {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 500;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        /* Terminal Output Area */
        .terminal-output {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-terminal);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-glow);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 16px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
        }

        .terminal-output::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
        }

        .terminal-output::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }

        .terminal-output::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--border-glow);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* Terminal Line */
        .terminal-line {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .line-prompt {
            color: var(--user-cursor);
            font-weight: 600;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .line-content {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            word-wrap: break-word;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .line-content.user {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .line-content.ai {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .line-content.thinking {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .line-content.success {
            color: var(--success);
        }

        .line-content.error {
            color: var(--error);
        }

        /* Action Indicator */
        .action-indicator {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .action-indicator::before {
            content: '';
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); }
        }

        .action-indicator.success::before {
            background: var(--success);
        }

        .action-indicator.error::before {
            background: var(--error);
        }

        /* Command Input */
        .command-input-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-glow);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            gap: 12px;
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
        }

        .command-input-container:focus-within {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .input-prompt {
            color: var(--user-cursor);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .command-input {
            flex: 1;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 13px;
            font-family: inherit;
            line-height: 1.5;
            -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
        }

        .command-input::placeholder {
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .send-trigger {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .send-trigger:hover {
            background: var(--text-primary);
            color: var(--bg-dark);
        }

        .send-trigger:disabled {
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: not-allowed;
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        .send-trigger svg {
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
        }

        /* Voice Button */
        .voice-trigger {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-glow);
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .voice-trigger:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .voice-trigger svg {
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
        }

        /* Markdown Code */
        .terminal-line code {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .terminal-line pre {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            margin: 8px 0;
        }

        .terminal-line pre code {
            background: transparent;
            padding: 0;
        }

        /* Window Drag Handle */
        .drag-handle {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 40px;
            -webkit-app-region: drag;
            z-index: 10;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="drag-handle"></div>

    <div class="lite-container">
        <!-- Header -->
        <div class="lite-header">
            <div class="lite-logo">Control</div>
            <div class="lite-mode">Agentic</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Terminal Output -->
        <div class="terminal-output" id="terminalOutput">
            <!-- Terminal lines populated via JS -->
        </div>

        <!-- Command Input -->
        <div class="command-input-container">
            <span class="input-prompt">&gt;</span>
            <input type="text" class="command-input" id="commandInput" placeholder="Enter command..." autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
            <button class="voice-trigger" id="voiceBtn" title="Voice input">
                <i class="fas fa-microphone"></i>
            </button>
            <button class="send-trigger" id="sendBtn" disabled title="Execute">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="5"></line>
                    <polyline points="5 12 12 5 19 12"></polyline>
                </svg>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script src="./js/lib/marked.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        class LiteAgent {
            constructor() {
                this.terminal = document.getElementById('terminalOutput');
                this.input = document.getElementById('commandInput');
                this.sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
                this.voiceBtn = document.getElementById('voiceBtn');
                this.isStreaming = false;
                this.currentLine = null;
                this.pendingActions = [];

                this.init();
            }

            async init() {
                this.setupListeners();

                // Load own event handlers (don't share with classic window)
                window.chatAPI.removeAllListeners('ai-stream');
                window.chatAPI.removeAllListeners('ai-response');
                window.chatAPI.removeAllListeners('action-start');
                window.chatAPI.removeAllListeners('action-complete');
                window.chatAPI.removeAllListeners('settings-updated');

                window.chatAPI.onAIStream((e, data) => this.handleStream(data.chunk));
                window.chatAPI.onAIResponse((e, data) => this.handleResponse(data));
                window.chatAPI.onActionStart((e, data) => this.logAction(data.description, 'running'));
                window.chatAPI.onActionComplete((e, data) => this.updateAction(data.description, data.success ? 'success' : 'error'));
                window.chatAPI.onSettingsUpdated((e, s) => this.applySettings(s));

                this.addLine('Ready to execute commands...', 'ai', 'system');
                this.input.focus();
            }

            setupListeners() {
                this.sendBtn.onclick = () => this.sendMessage();

                this.input.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    this.sendBtn.disabled = !this.input.value.trim();
                });

                this.input.onkeydown = (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.sendMessage();
                    }
                };
            }

            applySettings(settings) {
                // Lite window has its own theme handling
            }

            addLine(content, sender = 'ai', type = 'normal') {
                const line = document.createElement('div');
                line.className = 'terminal-line';

                if (sender === 'user') {
                    line.innerHTML = `
                        <span class="line-prompt">&gt;</span>
                        <span class="line-content user">${this.escapeHtml(content)}</span>
                    `;
                } else if (sender === 'ai') {
                    const contentClass = type === 'thinking' ? 'ai thinking' : (type === 'system' ? 'ai' : 'ai');
                    line.innerHTML = `
                        <span class="line-prompt" style="color: var(--ai-cursor);">&lt;</span>
                        <span class="line-content ${contentClass}">${content}</span>
                    `;
                }

                this.terminal.appendChild(line);
                this.scrollToBottom();
                return line;
            }

            sendMessage() {
                const text = this.input.value.trim();
                if (!text) return;

                // Add user line
                this.addLine(text, 'user');
                this.input.value = '';
                this.sendBtn.disabled = true;

                // Add thinking indicator
                this.addLine('Processing...', 'ai', 'thinking');

                // Execute task
                window.chatAPI.executeTask({ text, attachments: [] }, 'act');
            }

            handleStream(chunk) {
                if (!this.currentLine) {
                    this.currentLine = this.addLine('', 'ai', 'thinking');
                }

                const content = this.currentLine.querySelector('.line-content');
                if (content.textContent.includes('Processing...')) {
                    content.textContent = '';
                }

                content.textContent += chunk;
                this.scrollToBottom();
            }

            handleResponse(data) {
                const text = data.text || data.message || '';

                if (this.currentLine) {
                    this.currentLine.querySelector('.line-content').innerHTML = marked.parse(text) || this.escapeHtml(text);
                    this.currentLine = null;
                } else {
                    this.addLine(text, 'ai');
                }
            }

            logAction(description, status) {
                const line = document.createElement('div');
                line.className = 'terminal-line';
                line.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="line-prompt" style="color: var(--accent);">*</span>
                    <span class="line-content ai">
                        ${this.escapeHtml(description)}
                        <div class="action-indicator ${status}">${status === 'running' ? 'Executing' : 'Complete'}</div>
                    </span>
                `;
                this.terminal.appendChild(line);
                this.scrollToBottom();
            }

            updateAction(description, status) {
                const lines = this.terminal.querySelectorAll('.terminal-line');
                for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    const line = lines[i];
                    if (line.textContent.includes(description)) {
                        const indicator = line.querySelector('.action-indicator');
                        if (indicator) {
                            indicator.className = `action-indicator ${status}`;
                            indicator.textContent = status === 'success' ? 'Done' : 'Failed';
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
                this.scrollToBottom();
            }

            scrollToBottom() {
                this.terminal.scrollTop = this.terminal.scrollHeight;
            }

            escapeHtml(text) {
                if (!text) return '';
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.textContent = text;
                return div.innerHTML;
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            window.liteAgent = new LiteAgent();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
````
