## File: .github/workflows/build.yml
````yaml
name: Build Desktop App

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: windows
            python_zip: python-windows.zip
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: macos
            python_zip: python-macos.zip
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux
            python_zip: python-linux.zip

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Setup assets directories
        run: |
          mkdir -p assets/binaries
          mkdir -p assets/vosk
        shell: bash

      - name: Download and extract Vosk model
        run: |
          curl -L -o vosk-model.zip "https://github.com/Greatness0123/Controlrebuildv3/releases/download/assets/vosk-model.zip"
          unzip -o vosk-model.zip -d assets/
          rm vosk-model.zip
        shell: bash

      - name: Download and extract platform-specific Python binaries
        if: matrix.python_zip != ''
        run: |
          mkdir -p assets/binaries
          curl -L -o python.zip "https://github.com/Greatness0123/Controlrebuildv3/releases/download/assets/${{ matrix.python_zip }}"
          unzip -o python.zip -d assets/binaries/
          rm python.zip
        shell: bash

      - name: Verify assets structure
        run: |
          echo "=== Assets directory ==="
          ls -la assets/
          echo "=== Vosk model (if exists) ==="
          ls -la assets/vosk-model* 2>/dev/null || echo "No vosk model found"
          echo "=== Binaries directory ==="
          ls -la assets/binaries/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No binaries found"
        shell: bash

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        shell: bash

      - name: Post-install hook
        run: npm run postinstall
        shell: bash

      - name: Build the Electron app
        run: npm run dist
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
        id: build

      - name: List all dist files
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        run: |
          echo "=== dist/ contents ==="
          ls -la dist/
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload Windows NSIS installer
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: windows-nsis
          path: dist/Control Setup*.exe

      - name: Upload Windows Portable
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: windows-portable
          path: dist/Control 1.0.0.exe

      - name: List macOS dist
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        run: |
          ls -la dist/*.dmg || echo "No dmg files"
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload macOS Intel
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: macos-intel
          path: dist/Control-1.0.0.dmg

      - name: Upload macOS ARM64
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: macos-arm64
          path: dist/Control-1.0.0-arm64.dmg

      - name: List Linux dist
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        run: |
          ls -la dist/*.AppImage dist/*.deb || echo "No files"
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload Linux AppImage
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: linux-appimage
          path: dist/*.AppImage

      - name: Upload Linux deb
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: linux-deb
          path: dist/*.deb

      - name: Upload macOS unpacked
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: macos-unpacked
          path: dist/mac/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload Linux unpacked
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: linux-unpacked
          path: dist/linux-unpacked/
          retention-days: 7

  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: Create GitHub Release with all installers
        run: |
          set -e
          shopt -s nullglob
          
          TAG_NAME=$(git describe --tags --always --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "latest")
          
          echo "=== Listing all artifacts ==="
          find artifacts/ -type f \( -name "*.exe" -o -name "*.dmg" -o -name "*.AppImage" -o -name "*.deb" \)
          
          echo "=== Windows NSIS ==="
          ls -la artifacts/windows-nsis/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No windows-nsis"
          echo "=== Windows Portable ==="
          ls -la artifacts/windows-portable/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No windows-portable"
          
          # Collect files into an array
          FILES=()
          
          # Windows installers
          for f in artifacts/windows-nsis/*.exe; do FILES+=("$f"); done
          for f in artifacts/windows-portable/*.exe; do FILES+=("$f"); done
          
          # macOS
          for f in artifacts/macos-intel/*.dmg; do FILES+=("$f"); done
          for f in artifacts/macos-arm64/*.dmg; do FILES+=("$f"); done
          
          # Linux
          for f in artifacts/linux-appimage/*.AppImage; do FILES+=("$f"); done
          for f in artifacts/linux-deb/*.deb; do FILES+=("$f"); done
          
          echo "Files to upload: ${#FILES[@]}"
          
          # Create release
          gh release create "$TAG_NAME" \
            "${FILES[@]}" \
            --draft \
            --title "Control Desktop App ($TAG_NAME)" \
            --notes "Auto-built from GitHub Actions"
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
````
